prompt: Complete the command that changes a database endpoint's proxy policy.
explanation: `rladmin bind db db:1 endpoint 1:1 policy all-nodes` binds the endpoint to the proxies on all nodes, spreading incoming traffic across the cluster. `migrate` moves shards or endpoints between nodes, `tune` adjusts numeric or policy parameters, and `placement` sets the shard placement policy — none of them change which proxies are bound to an endpoint.
template: To put an active proxy on every node for the sessions database, run: rladmin ___ db db:1 endpoint 1:1 policy all-nodes
